payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustive triple loop with early exit when an acute angle is found; if n > 69, output 0 based on geometric bound.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all triples (i,j,k) to test for acute angles, breaking loops upon finding a bad point. For larger n, it assumes no good points exist. This is a complete search with a heuristic threshold, closest to branch and bound among given subtypes.
